prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC happy-mouth viseme atlas. Use exactly one reference: the supplied local NPC075 happy-mouth-v2 mouth-reference-grid.png.

Output exactly a 3-column by 3-row atlas. It contains exactly nine cells, no more and no less. Every cell is one complete native 64×29 lower-half crop (the original portrait rows y=35..63), retaining the source framing and pixel scale. Thus the entire atlas is exactly a 192×87 layout with overall width:height ratio 64:29 (about 2.2069:1). Fill the canvas edge to edge with exactly 3 columns and 3 rows. No padding, borders, labels, dividers, extra bottom band, fourth row, neck, shoulders, or content below the original 64×29 crop. Do not add any extra panels.

Cell positions in row-major order:
top-left A: closed lips with light pressure for P/B/M.
top-middle B: slight opening, nearly together teeth, narrow horizontal gap for most consonants/EE.
top-right C: medium relaxed unrounded opening for EH/AE.
middle-left D: wide vertical AA opening, clearly wider than C but still small and within the source mouth size.
middle-middle E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
middle-right F: small forward puckered UW/OW/W opening, not a tooth bite.
bottom-left G: upper teeth touch the lower lip for F/V; not a wide vowel.
bottom-middle H: raised tongue behind upper teeth for long L, opening between C and D.
bottom-right X: relaxed closed idle lips with a gentle natural smile.

Keep the NPC075 identity and original lower-face appearance: small restrained mouth, muted brown-rose lip hue, soft warm skin palette, fine native pixel clusters, unchanged nose/chin, hair and face side edges exactly as in the reference. Keep the happy expression friendly and subtle, not a huge grin, laugh, grimace, or lipstick look. Any visible teeth are tiny muted gray-ivory, never bright white. Keep all mouth changes inside the original mouth area; do not repaint broad skin or alter the lower-face framing.

Important canvas check: exactly nine mouth panels in a 3×3 grid occupying the full output. The bottom row must contain only G, H, X crops from y=35..63; after that row the image ends. No extra neck/shoulder strip. No text or watermark.
